sourceLabel: 中国学术论文编写基础（GB/T 7713.2—2022）
description: 检查中国学术论文的基础结构，并提示作者确认当前尚不能可靠自动判定的著者、单位和中英文元数据。
descriptionEn: Checks the basic structure of Chinese academic papers and asks authors to confirm author, affiliation, and bilingual metadata that cannot yet be determined reliably.

rules.message: 请确认论文已按目标期刊要求说明基金或资助信息；无资助时也应确认是否需要明确声明。
rules.messageEn: Confirm that funding or support is reported as required by the target journal, including an explicit no-funding statement when applicable.

rules.message: 请核对作者姓名、单位、通讯作者和联系方式；当前版本尚未可靠解析这些字段。
rules.messageEn: Verify author names, affiliations, corresponding author, and contact details; this version does not yet parse these fields reliably.

rules.message: 请确认目标期刊要求的中文与英文标题、摘要和关键词是否齐全。
rules.messageEn: Confirm whether the target journal requires both Chinese and English titles, abstracts, and keywords.
